newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar futures end near lows, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar futures end near lows, trade thin.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures succumbed to trade selling on the close and settled a thinly-traded session barely below unchanged, floor sources said.

The March contract finished under support seen around 10.50, an indication of possible weakness Thursday. But today's low remained above the low of 10.42 made Tuesday, suggesting a temporary bottom at that level, dealers said.
They said the market's dull tone is likely to persist amid a lack of physical offtake, which could eventually pressure the March contract towards 10.00.
Nearby support was seen at 10.35 and then 10.21.
"If we go through that we can expect (March) to go to 10.00 in the next couple of weeks," a floor source said.
March closed down 0.02 at 10.47 having ranged from 10.57 to 10.45. The back months settled unchanged and 0.01 weaker.
Volume was estimated at only 8,470 lots.
